:::{#def-scalar-mult}
#### Scalar multiplication

The **scalar multiple** of a matrix $\matr{A}$ by a scalar $c$ is:

$$(c\matr{A})_{ij} = c \cdot a_{ij}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-scalar-mult}
#### A scalar multiple

$$
\begin{aligned}
3 \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 4 \end{bmatrix}
&= \begin{bmatrix} 3 \cd 1 & 3 \cd (-2) \\ 3 \cd 0 & 3 \cd 4 \end{bmatrix} \\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -6 \\ 0 & 12 \end{bmatrix}.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
